title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝
summary: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「水頭與試驗壓差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Compression and groove geometry" and "Water head and test differential": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression and groove geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。 假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete. Actual groove and joint geometry, not nominal gasket height alone, governs installed contact. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compression and groove geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compression and groove geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression and groove geometry" is correct?
options: 只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。
止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。
短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。
optionsEn: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact.

quiz.explanation: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compression and groove geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 止水墊反力越大越好，不必檢查混凝土溝槽劈裂。

Passing straight-strip tests makes all corner-intersection testing unnecessary.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compression and groove geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄壓縮量與溝槽幾何的資料來源與適用條件。量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for compression and groove geometry. Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression and groove geometry"?

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compression and groove geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期應力鬆弛」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term stress relaxation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 長期應力鬆弛：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期應力鬆弛」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term stress relaxation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
直線墊條試驗合格就可以省略全部角部交會試驗。
外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Passing straight-strip tests makes all corner-intersection testing unnecessary.
An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life.

quiz.explanationEn: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 角部與交叉接點：機制與系統路徑

steps.instructionEn: At corners the sealing line turns and meets other joints, creating complex local compression and rubber connections. A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection. Repairs that alter corner thickness can additionally create uneven compression immediately beside the repaired location. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corners and intersecting joints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bonding and surface compatibility" and "Assembly contamination and local defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏貼與表面相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bonding and surface compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏貼與表面相容」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bonding and surface compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。溝槽污染、含水和不相容材料可能降低固定效果，必須遵循核准產品系統而非任意混用。 假設長2 m墊條有0.1 m未固定，缺失長度5%；即使比例小，局部移位仍可能切斷止水線。 運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏貼與表面相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bonding holds a gasket through handling and assembly, but final sealing still depends on compression and continuous contact. Contamination, moisture and incompatible materials weaken retention, requiring an approved system rather than improvised substitutions. If an assumed 2 m strip has 0.1 m unretained, the missing length is 5%; a small displaced portion can still interrupt the sealing line. A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bonding and surface compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 砂粒、混凝土碎屑與墊條折疊會把連續接觸切成局部橋接，水沿未壓緊處繞行。這類缺陷不一定改變整體縫寬，因此需要可追溯外觀檢查與後續漏點對照。 假設一條2 m密封線有5 mm夾雜區，占0.25%；此比例不能代表水密損失只有0.25%。 增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安裝污染與局部缺陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水密試驗與追溯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Watertight tests and traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「產品通過證書可以取代現地接縫幾何和批次追溯。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A product pass certificate replaces field joint geometry and batch traceability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
